lines: On an RTX 3070, Statim makes 68 decisions per second.
You no longer need Python, PyTorch or a heavy stack to run your System-One decision model.
Statim is a native C++20 engine for System-One decision models that runs without Python.
It loads a small binary and model file, then routes each request to its own adapted weights for instant answers.
Type a question like billing or urgency, then receive an answer with probabilities for each choice within milliseconds.
Against Ryzen 7 5800X CPU, Statim runs in 257 ms per state for short inputs while ONNX Runtime takes 266.
On S1Bench with 3,880 items, the multilingual model scores 0.638 macro.
A rank-4 adapter uses 3.3 MB and adds 17–28 % CPU latency.
It runs on Linux x86-64 with AVX2 and supports Vulkan for GPU acceleration.
Apache-2.0 licence from BEKO2210 with one GitHub star.
Download statim using curl to get a small binary file.
Send this to someone who needs a faster System-One model without Python.
Statim is the only choice for fast CPU or Vulkan GPU.
